data.cultural_impact: Kalidasan is a name revered in Indian culture, synonymous with excellence in art and literature. The name has been carried forward through generations, inspiring countless individuals in their creative pursuits. One of the most famous Kalidasas in history is the renowned Sanskrit poet and scholar, Kalidasa, who wrote works of art that have stood the test of time. His most notable works include "Meghadutam," "Ritusamhara," and "Shakuntala." Today, the name Kalidasan continues to represent artistic brilliance and is a source of pride for Hindus all over the world.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, the name Kalidasan is a reminder of devotion and surrender to the Divine Mother, Kali. Kali is revered as the eternal cosmic power and represents destruction, transformation, and creation. The name Kalidasan signifies a close relationship with Kali, as a devotee or servant. Sarawak Kalidasan, a famous Indian saint, is an example of spiritual devotion to Kali. The name Kalidasan signifies a life dedicated to seeking blessings from Kali, and striving for spiritual growth and self-realization.

historical_references.reference: Kalidasa is believed to have lived during the 4th to 5th centuries CE, and his works are considered the pinnacle of Sanskrit literature. He wrote plays, poems, and scientific texts.
Kalidasa's most famous works include the plays 'Shakuntala' and 'Meghaduta', and the poem 'Ritusamhara'. His works were influential in the development of classical Indian drama and literature.

modern_usage.modern_context: Kalidasan is a renowned ancient Indian Sanskrit poet, playwright, and philosopher. In modern times, his works continue to influence various fields. In literature, his plays and poems are translated and studied in schools and universities around the world. In performing arts, Kalidasan's works are staged in various productions, both traditional and contemporary, in India and beyond. In visual arts, his works are the inspiration behind numerous paintings, sculptures, and other artistic expressions. Through stage shows, literary festivals, and museum exhibitions, Kalidasan's influence is felt across generations and cultures.

seo.description_paragraph: Kalidasan is a Sanskrit name that holds deep significance in Hinduism. The name translates to 'servant of Kali', reflecting the devotion and reverence towards the Hindu goddess of power and destruction. In Hindu mythology, Kali is often depicted as a goddess of time, creation, and preservation, and is known for her fierce and protective nature. As a name, Kalidasan is a testament to the deep-rooted cultural and religious traditions of Hinduism and its rich history and symbolism.
